sync.blocked.generic: The server refused this change. It is kept on this device as a draft.
sync.blocked.quota_exceeded: The vault is full. Delete something and try again.
sync.blocked.restore_epoch_refused: The server was restored while this change was waiting to be sent, and it did not accept the change. The change is kept on this device and nothing was deleted.
sync.blocked.reupload_refused: The server holds a different version of this item than the copy this device kept, so the copy was not uploaded again. The copy stays on this device and nothing is lost.
sync.blocked.storage: This browser could not save the change on this device.
sync.conflict.confirm_theirs: Click again to keep the server's
sync.conflict.deleted_mine: You deleted this item on this device.
sync.conflict.deleted_theirs: This item was deleted on the server.
sync.conflict.drops_mine: The server's version of this item is dropped for good, on every device. Your version replaces it.
sync.conflict.drops_theirs: Your version on this device is dropped for good. The server's version stays.
sync.conflict.heading: This item was changed in two places
sync.conflict.intro: This item was changed on this device and somewhere else before the two could be brought together. Choose the version to keep. Nothing is merged, and the version you do not keep is dropped.
sync.ended.token_reused: Signed out because this device's sign-in token was used from somewhere else. That can mean the token was copied. Sign in again, and check the device list in the web vault.
sync.error.another_server: This device is signed in at another server than the one shown. Close the popup and open it again.
sync.error.bad_feed: The server sent a list of changes that cannot be right. Nothing was changed on this device.
sync.error.busy: Ferret is signing in or unlocking right now. Wait until that is done, then try again.
sync.error.changed: Something changed since the question was asked. Nothing was forgotten. Ask again.
sync.error.forget_incomplete: Not everything of this server could be removed from this device. Try again: what was removed stays removed.
sync.error.invalid_state: This cannot be done right now.
sync.error.network: The server could not be reached. Try again later.
sync.error.not_confirmed: That is not the word. Nothing was changed.
sync.error.not_verified: The server's older state does not check out against what this device has verified, so it was not accepted. Nothing was changed or deleted. Leave sync stopped, or forget this server. Trying again will not help unless the server changes.
sync.error.not_verified_no_checkpoint: The server's older state does not check out against what this device has verified, so it was not accepted. Nothing was changed or deleted. Leave sync stopped, or forget this server. Trying again will not help unless the server changes. The server holds no checkpoint to compare the older state with.
sync.error.sync_not_running: Sync is not running. Unlock the vault first.
sync.error.sync_still_halted: The cause is still there, so sync stays stopped.
sync.error.unknown: That did not work. Nothing was changed on this device.
sync.error.vault_locked: The vault was locked while Ferret worked. Unlock it and try again.
sync.error.worker_failed: The part of Ferret that holds your keys stopped. Unlock again and try again.
sync.forget.body: This device will forget this server and your account: the saved items, the trash, the record of what the server showed before, and the secret key if this device remembers it. The device is signed out at the server. Nothing on the server is deleted. The next sign-in on this device counts as the first one, and you will need your secret key then.
sync.forget.body_pending: This device will forget this server and your account: the saved items, the trash, the record of what the server showed before, and the secret key if this device remembers it. The device is signed out at the server. Nothing on the server is deleted. The next sign-in on this device counts as the first one, and you will need your secret key then. Changes not yet sent to the server, which will be lost: {count}.
sync.forget.body_shared: This device will forget this server and your account: the record of what the server showed before, and the secret key if this device remembers it. The same account is also remembered under another address of this server, so the saved items, the trash and the sync flags are kept for that address. The device is signed out at the server. Nothing on the server is deleted. The next sign-in on this device counts as the first one, and you will need your secret key then.
sync.forget.body_shared_pending: This device will forget this server and your account: the record of what the server showed before, and the secret key if this device remembers it. The same account is also remembered under another address of this server, so the saved items, the trash and the sync flags are kept for that address. The device is signed out at the server. Nothing on the server is deleted. The next sign-in on this device counts as the first one, and you will need your secret key then. Changes not yet sent to the server, which stay saved for that address and are not lost: {count}.
sync.forget.body_unknown: This device will forget this server and your account: the saved items, the trash, the record of what the server showed before, and the secret key if this device remembers it. The device is signed out at the server. Nothing on the server is deleted. The next sign-in on this device counts as the first one, and you will need your secret key then. Changes on this device that were not sent to the server yet, if there are any, will be lost.
sync.forget.title: Forget this server on this device?
sync.item.error.busy: An older state of the server is being accepted. Try again in a moment.
sync.item.error.conflict_changed: The server's version of this item changed while you were looking at it. Nothing was done. Both versions are shown again, so you can choose again.
sync.item.error.conflict_unsettled: The server's version of this item has not arrived yet. Try again in a moment.
sync.item.error.in_conflict: This item has a conflict: choose a version instead.
sync.item.error.invalid_state: This cannot be done right now.
sync.item.error.not_found: This item does not wait for a choice any more. Nothing was done.
sync.item.error.not_offered: This list is out of date. Open it again.
sync.item.error.not_shown: Look at both versions again before you choose. Nothing was done.
sync.item.error.sync_not_running: Sync is not running. Unlock the vault first.
sync.item.error.unknown: That did not work. Nothing was changed on this device.
sync.item.error.vault_locked: The vault is locked. Unlock it and try again.
sync.item.error.worker_failed: The part of Ferret that holds your keys stopped. Unlock again and try again.
sync.items.discard_question: Your change of this item is dropped for good, and the server's version stays. Discard it?
sync.items.heading: Changes that are not on the server yet
sync.items.none: Nothing waits. Every change is on the server.
sync.older.conflicts_note: Every item that already exists on the server comes back as a conflict, and a device that was behind can have many of them, also for items that nobody changed after the restore, because this device cannot tell which ones changed. Often both versions are the same or the server's is the newer one. You choose which version to keep, and nothing is overwritten without your choice.
sync.older.done: Done. This device follows the server again. Your newer changes sent to the server: {reuploaded}. Items with a conflict for you to decide: {conflicts}.
sync.older.done_conflicts: {count} items need your decision. This can be many, also for items that nobody changed after the restore, because this device cannot tell which ones changed. Nothing was overwritten.
sync.older.done_release: Done. This device follows the server again. Your newer changes sent to the server: {reuploaded}. Changes kept on this device as unsent drafts: {conflicts}.
sync.older.error.bad_feed: The server sent a list of changes that cannot be right. Nothing was changed on this device.
sync.older.error.busy: Sync is busy accepting an older state. Wait a moment, then try again.
sync.older.error.failed: The older state could not be accepted. Sync stays stopped and nothing was deleted. Try again, or forget this server.
sync.older.error.invalid_state: There is nothing to accept any more: the older state may already have been accepted, or the server changed. Nothing was deleted. Go back and look at the sync again.
sync.older.error.not_confirmed: That is not the word. Nothing was changed.
sync.older.error.not_verified: The server's older state does not check out against what this device has verified, so it was not accepted. Nothing was changed or deleted. Leave sync stopped, or forget this server. Trying again will not help unless the server changes.
sync.older.error.not_verified_no_checkpo: The server's older state does not check out against what this device has verified, so it was not accepted. Nothing was changed or deleted. Leave sync stopped, or forget this server. Trying again will not help unless the server changes. The server holds no checkpoint to compare the older state with.
sync.older.error.preview_failed: The server's older state could not be read, so the effect cannot be shown yet. Nothing was changed.
sync.older.error.vault_locked: The vault was locked. Unlock it and try again. Nothing was changed.
sync.older.error.word_wrong: That is not the word. Nothing was changed.
sync.older.heading: The server was restored
sync.older.intro_choice: If you accept, this device follows the server again from its older state. Changes you made here that the server does not have are sent to the server. If the server changed an item after it was restored, that item becomes a conflict and you choose which version to keep. Nothing is overwritten without your choice.
sync.older.intro_safe: The server now shows an older state than this device has seen before. This usually happens when the server is restored from a backup. Nothing on this device was deleted, and sync is stopped until you decide.
sync.older.intro_warn: Accept only if you know the server was restored. Accepting makes the older state this device's new starting point, and other devices will show the same notice. If you did not expect this, leave sync stopped or forget this server.
sync.older.manifest_older: The server was restored from before you last changed your unlock methods. Methods you added after the backup are gone, methods you removed are back, and the old password works again on the server. This device will refuse the older password at the next unlock. To put the newest unlock methods back, accept the older state in the web vault too and use “Reapply the unlock methods” there.
sync.older.preview_reupload: Your newer changes that will be sent to the server: {count}
sync.older.release_conflicts: This version of Ferret cannot show these conflicts yet, and the web vault cannot see them: they are this device's own changes, kept as unsent drafts. Nothing is sent for them and nothing was overwritten. Forgetting this server would drop them.
sync.older.unreadable: Items that could not be opened on this device and were not sent: {count}. They are kept as they are.
sync.status.unauthorized: Sign in again to go on
sync.stop.generic: Sync is stopped for a reason this version of Ferret has no text for. Nothing was deleted on this device, and nothing is fetched or sent until you choose.
sync.stop.restore_epoch_lowered: The server's restore number went down, which should never happen. Nothing was deleted on this device, and nothing is fetched or sent until you choose.
sync.stop.rollback_suspected: The server reports a position that is lower than this device has seen, which looks like a rollback. Nothing was deleted on this device, and nothing is fetched or sent until you choose.
sync.stop.server_restored: The server was restored to an earlier state. Nothing was deleted on this device, and nothing is fetched or sent until you choose. Look at what accepting the older state would do before you choose.
sync.stop.sync_memory_full: This device's record of the server is full and cannot take more. Nothing was deleted. The only way on is to forget this server on this device and sign in again.
sync.stop.title: Sync stopped
sync.stop.unsupported: This browser lacks a feature (Web Locks) that keeps the record of the server safe from being overwritten. Nothing was deleted. Use a current version of Firefox.
sync.warning.bad_feed: The server sent a list of changes that cannot be right. Nothing was changed on this device.
sync.warning.cached_row_dropped: A cached item could not be checked and was dropped from this device. It is read from the server again.
sync.warning.checkpoint_forged: The checkpoint on the server could not be verified with this vault's key, so it was ignored. Your items are not affected.
sync.warning.checkpoint_rolled_back: The newest checkpoint on the server is older than one this device has already checked. The server may have been rolled back. Nothing was deleted on this device. Checkpoints are not uploaded until a check succeeds.
sync.warning.checkpoint_upload_failed: A checkpoint could not be saved on the server. It is tried again later, so nothing was lost and you can keep working.
sync.warning.missing_on_server: The server's list did not show some items. They are kept on this device and uploaded again. Nothing was deleted.
sync.warning.restore_epoch_raised: The server reports a new restore number, but nothing it shows is older than what this device has seen.
sync.warning.rev_below_remembered: The server showed an older version of an item than this device has seen before. It was ignored.
sync.warning.rev_lower_than_local: The server showed an older version of an item than this device has. It was ignored.
sync.warning.rev_same_row_changed: The server showed a different item under a version this device already has. It was ignored.
sync.warning.row_damaged: An item from the server could not be opened. The last good version is kept.
sync.warning.server_hid_item: The server did not list an item it was holding. The item is kept on this device and nothing was deleted.
sync.warning.server_shows_older_state: The server shows an older state than this device has seen. Nothing was deleted on this device. Checkpoints are not uploaded until a check succeeds.
sync.warning.tombstone_unverified: The server says an item is deleted, but that could not be checked. The local copy is kept.
sync.warning.trash_copy_skipped: The server deleted an item, and no copy of it could be put in the trash on this device. The deletion was still applied here. The item cannot be restored from the trash on this device.
sync.warning.unexpected_rev: The server saved a change under an unexpected version number.
sync.warning.unknown: Sync found something on the server that is not right. Nothing was deleted on this device.
sync.warning.verify_deferred: Checkpoint checks are paused. An item that the server hid was uploaded again from this device, so the server's checkpoint cannot be compared with it until the item has been changed past its old version. No checkpoints are uploaded meanwhile. Nothing was deleted.
